works.title: Little Russian Philokalia, Vol. IV: St. Paisius Velichkovsky
works.author: St. Paisius Velichkovsky
works.blurb: A collection of the writings and counsels of St. Paisius, the renewer of Hesychasm and the Jesus Prayer in the Slavic lands, gathered in the Brotherhood's Little Russian Philokalia series.

works.title: Blessed Paisius Velichkovsky
works.subtitle: The Man Behind the Philokalia
works.author: Schemamonk Metrophanes
works.blurb: The classic life of St. Paisius, tracing his journey from Ukraine to Mount Athos and Moldavia, and his labors translating the Philokalia that rekindled the prayer of the heart across Orthodoxy.
